newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Cambodia seeks return of smuggled children.
newsitem.headline: Cambodia seeks return of smuggled children.

text.p: Phnom Penh has asked Italy to return four Cambodian children believed to have been kidnapped by a child smuggling ring.

Co-Premier Prince Norodom Ranariddh, in a communique released by his cabinet on Wednesday, also vowed to prosecute a Cambodian man arrested in Rome last month with a fake passport and the four children.
Italian police have not specified the nationality of the children.
"Samdech Krom Preah (Ranariddh) has requested the immediate and safe return of the four Cambodian children...," the communique stated.
It said Ranariddh had informed the Italian Embassy in Bangkok that his government would cooperate fully in the prosecution of the Cambodian man, Cao Leng Huot.
Huot was arrested on November 30 on arrival at Rome's Fiumicino airport on charges of kidnapping and promoting illegal immigration.
He was carrying a stolen Belgian passport, dozens of photographs of children and coded telephone numbers.
Police in Rome told reporters they suspected the case had links to an international child smuggling ring.
